findings.title: Present nonregular reviewed entries bypass the absent-reference boundary
findings.description: review_evidence_exists falls back to review_record_commit whenever revision_regular_file(reviewed) is false. That conflates absence with an existing symlink or directory. Independent real-Git probes commit an own-task reference as mode 120000 or 040000 at the reviewed revision, replace it with mode 100644 in an ancestral linear own-review-only suffix, and receive zero integration errors. Thread Review Contract v0.2 permits fallback only for a reference absent at reviewed_head_sha and expressly excludes symlinks and directories; the implementation therefore accepts a source binding outside the authorized exception.
findings.required_change: Prove that the exact normalized path has no Git entry at the reviewed SHA before allowing review-record fallback. Keep ordinary references bound to regular reviewed blobs, and add integration regressions rejecting symlink-to-regular and directory-to-regular replacement under an otherwise valid own-review-only suffix. Rerun required checks and fresh SHA-bound reviews after the fix.
